title: Hơi thở chậm
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): to breathe slowly to: the far sea swelling at the pace of a calm breath, a held pad, a singing bowl every so often. F major 7 and D minor at 44 bpm, about six minutes. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
